title: 访谈对话的结构
goal: 按提问与回应定位访谈信息，区分假设与经历。

points.label: 按提问与回应定位访谈信息
区分提问假设与受访者的经历

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表

cards.title: 结构
rows: Today we welcome Mira, a local baker.
引出过去的工作或活动
询问选择或变化的理由
Why did you change your recipe?
What do you plan to do next?
cards.note: 提问只引出话题，事实以受访者的回答为准。

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 过去经常的状态或行为
I used to bake at home.
At first I made only bread.
经过一段过程后的结果
I plan to teach a class.
cards.note: used to、at first、eventually 说的是已经发生的事。plan to 说的是还没有做的事。

body.box:
Host: Did you start by selling cakes?
Mira: No. At first I baked bread at home. Eventually I sold bread at the market. I plan to teach a class next year.

What did Mira do at first?
1. She taught a class at the market.
2. She baked bread at home.
3. She sold cakes at the market.
4. She sold bread at the market.

body.p: 主持人问 Mira 是不是从卖蛋糕开始，Mira 用 No 否定了。At first I baked bread at home 是她最初的经历，与第二项对应。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 受访者否定了卖蛋糕的假设。
卖面包是 eventually 之后的阶段。
Mira taught a class last year.
Mira changed a recipe to teach a class.
改配方的原因只从受访者对 Why 的回答里找。

lines.text: Today we're talking with painter Leo. Did you study painting at school?
No, I studied music. At first I painted at home after work. Eventually I joined a community art class.
What do you plan to do next?
I'll display my paintings in the library.

items.stem: What did Leo study at school?
options: Painting with the community art class.
Music during his school years.
Painting first, then music.
Painting after his workday.
items.why: 依据是 No, I studied music。Leo 否定了学画画的说法，他在学校学的是音乐，即第二项。

items.stem: What does Leo plan to do?
options: Study music at school again.
Paint at home after work, as before.
Start a community music class.
Show his paintings at the library.
items.why: 依据是 Leo 对计划的回答 I'll display my paintings in the library。display 改写为 show，即第四项。

lines.text: Today we're speaking with gardener Tess. Did you start with a large garden?
No. At first I grew herbs in a few pots. Eventually I rented a small garden. I chose it because it was close to home.
What will you grow next?
I plan to add flowers beside the herbs.

items.stem: Why did Tess choose the small garden?
options: It was near where she lived.
It contained many flowers.
It had space for large pots.
It was farther from her home.
items.why: 依据是 I chose it because it was close to home。close to home 改写为 near where she lived，即第一项。

options: She rented a large garden.
She planted flowers at home.
She grew herbs in containers.
She added pots to a rented plot.
items.why: 依据是 At first I grew herbs in a few pots。pots 改写为 containers，即第三项；租小园子是后来的事。

lines.text: Today we welcome Mara, who repairs musical instruments. Did you begin by working in a music shop?

No. I used to play the violin in a small orchestra. At first I only replaced the strings on my own instrument. When a friend asked me to help with hers, I became interested in repairs. Eventually I took a course and began working in a repair shop.
Why did you choose a repair course?
I wanted to learn how to work on instruments without damaging them. The course included practical lessons as well as advice about different materials.
What do you plan to do next?
I plan to run a short workshop for players. I'll show them how to care for strings between visits to a repairer.

items.stem: What did Mara do before she studied repairs?
options: She played in an orchestra.
She taught a repair course.
She worked in a music shop.
She ran a workshop for players.
items.why: 依据是 I used to play the violin in a small orchestra。Mara 学修理之前在乐团拉小提琴，即第一项；在乐器店工作是主持人的猜测，她用 No 否定了。

items.stem: Why did Mara take a repair course?
options: To start playing in an orchestra.
To teach friends to replace strings.
To learn to repair instruments safely.
To find a shop selling new instruments.
items.why: 依据是 I wanted to learn how to work on instruments without damaging them。without damaging them 改写为 safely，即第三项。

items.stem: What does Mara plan to do for players?
options: Repair players' strings at each visit.
Offer a workshop about string care.
Join their orchestra as a teacher.
Sell them materials from her course.
items.why: 依据是 I plan to run a short workshop for players 和 show them how to care for strings。她要办一个讲琴弦保养的短期课，即第二项。

lines.text: Our guest is Arun, who makes maps for visitors to the marsh. Arun, did you learn about the marsh by reading books first?
Not at first. I used to walk there with my grandfather, who showed me the paths. Later I read about the plants and birds. Eventually I began drawing maps for friends who wanted to visit.
Why did you add information about plants?
Friends wanted to know what they were seeing. I added short descriptions beside the paths, and a local teacher checked them for me. The maps also show where visitors can rest.
Are you making another map now?
Yes. I plan to finish a map of the northern path this summer. It will include the resting places and the bridge near the entrance.

items.stem: How did Arun first learn about the marsh?
options: He read a teacher's descriptions.
He drew maps of the northern path.
He asked friends about the plants.
He walked there with his grandfather.
items.why: 依据是 I used to walk there with my grandfather。Arun 用 Not at first 否定了先读书的说法，他最初是跟祖父去湿地散步，即第四项。

items.stem: Why did Arun include plant information?
options: A teacher needed a map of the bridge.
His grandfather planned a northern path.
His friends wanted to identify plants.
Visitors wanted to know where to rest.
items.why: 依据是 Friends wanted to know what they were seeing。朋友想知道看到的是什么植物，即第三项；标出休息处是地图的另一项内容。

items.stem: Which event happened after Arun's walks with his grandfather?
options: He first visited the marsh with friends.
He read about the plants and birds.
He learned the paths from his teacher.
He completed the northern map in summer.
items.why: 依据是 Later I read about the plants and birds。Later 说明读书在跟祖父散步之后，即第二项。
